read.text: NFLX's daily swings show lower highs and lower lows; the last structure break was down on Oct 23, when it closed below $66.54. On weekly bars it is in a downtrend (below its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show lower highs and lower lows.
The nearest support zone is $61.15–$61.63, where price turned 1 times, most recently on Oct 29; the nearest resistance zone is $64.84–$65.32, where price turned 1 times, most recently on Jul 17.
Over the last 60 sessions it has moved in a falling channel (fit R² 0.88) and sits in the upper half of the channel.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 7 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 4 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-2.9%) came on light volume.
RSI is 40 (neutral); MACD is above its signal line since Nov 4.
A daily close above $65.32 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $61.15 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
